description: Coloured window glazing used to shield shelved books from the disintegrating action of direct sunlight. Pale yellow and olive-green shades filter the most damaging rays and protect leather, whereas blue and violet glass pass nearly as harmful a light as clear glass.
name: tinted glass

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XXI, p.291. Internet Archive.
